units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 103b:10">B. Mets. 103ᵇ</cite> <he>קני דח׳ וכ׳</he> (Ar. Var. <he>חרזא</he>, <cite ref="H00878"><he>חירזא</he></cite>, v. Ar. ed. Koh. s. v. <cite ref="A03131"><he>ארכבתא</he></cite>) the poles for the shrub (to be put up as a hedge on top of the earth mound) must be supplied by the landlord, but the shrub itself by the tenant.
<cite ref="Nedarim 41b:1">Ned. 41ᵇ</cite> top <he>כח׳ לדיקלא</he> as its prickles protect the palm-tree (v.

<cite ref="Berakhot 8a:13">Ber. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>כח׳ בגבבא דעמרא וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>לח׳ דשלפא מגבבא וכ׳</he>) as a thorn in a ball of wool which (if one tries to tear loose) lacerates backward (in the opposite direction of its knots), v. <cite ref="N01346"><he>נְשַׁר</he> I</cite>.—Pl. <he>חִיזְרֵי</he>.

<cite ref="Shabbat 63b">Sabb. 63ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Beitzah 29b:4">Bets. 29ᵇ</cite>, a. e. (proverbial expression) (<he>שקילי … ושדי</he>) <he>שקילא טיבותיך ושדיא אח׳</he> thy good-natured advice is taken and thrown over the hedge, i.e. thy advice comes too late.
<cite ref="Berakhot 12b:1">Ber. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>כרע כח׳</he> he bent (in prayer) like a cane (when it is swung).
